name: odd-rendering-compiler
description: Build-time pipeline: TEI ODD Processing Model → CSS, XSLT, unified/xast handlers, and CETEIcean behaviours — with end-to-end HTML rendering for static editions

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:xslt && npm run build:unified && npm run build:ceteicean
scripts.render:all: npm run render:xslt && npm run render:unified && npm run render:interactive && npm run render:islands
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run build:unified && npm run render:unified && npm run render:interactive
scripts.build:extension: node odd-to-css.mjs --odd ../examples/extensions/nested-pb/tei_simler-nested-pb.odd --tokens ../examples/simler-tokens.css --out output/nested-pb && node odd-to-unified.mjs --odd ../examples/extensions/nested-pb/tei_simler-nested-pb.odd --out output/nested-pb

author: Christian Forney
